mapper.sql: select id, merchant_id, product_id, service_name, service_image, service_price, description, stock, status, sort, create_time, update_time, remark, del_flag from mall_booking_service
mapper.select: where product_id = #{productId} and del_flag = '0' order by status desc, sort asc, id asc limit 1

and del_flag = '0' and status = 1 and ( product_id is null or exists ( select 1 from product p where p.id = mall_booking_service.product_id and p.status = 1 and p.del_flag = '0' ) ) and merchant_id = #{merchantId} and service_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')
order by sort asc, id asc
mapper.insert: insert into mall_booking_service ( merchant_id, product_id, service_name, service_image, service_price, description, stock, status, sort, create_time, update_time, remark, del_flag ) select p.merchant_id, p.id, p.name, p.cover_image, p.price, p.description, p.stock, 1, p.sort, now(), now(), '由上架商品自动生成预约服务', '0' from product p where p.status = 1 and p.del_flag = '0' and p.merchant_id = #{merchantId} and not exists ( select 1 from mall_booking_service s where s.product_id = p.id and s.del_flag = '0' )
mapper.select:
select coalesce(unix_timestamp(max(coalesce(update_time, create_time))), 0) from mall_booking_service
and del_flag = '0' and merchant_id = #{merchantId}
